name: Kamura Saki
source: A slightly mysterious classmate of Touki's. Saki is a transfer student who is expressionless with an indifferent attitude. Due to her personality, she doesn't care about communicating with people and is shown to be only interested in music. Being orphaned from a young age, she has come to Tokyo alone.
